# pantechdynamics_domain (Resource)

A domain name registered through Pantech. Registering a domain charges your organization's credit and cannot be undone. Create places the order, takes the price from your organization's credit (a failed order returns it) and waits until the registration succeeds. When credit does not cover it, the order waits an hour for the difference (in US dollars your saved card is charged it, and a payment link appears only if your bank asks you to confirm the payment; in naira, add credit): the apply stops, and once the order is paid, apply again and the domain is taken into state without a second order. **Destroying this resource does not delete, cancel or release the domain**: a registration cannot be undone, so destroy only removes it from Terraform state, and the domain stays in your organization (turn auto_renew off to let it expire). With name_servers unset the domain uses Pantech DNS: create a pantechdynamics_dns_zone with the same name to serve its records. Only an API key made by an owner or admin can register or change domains.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Registering a domain charges your organization's credit and cannot be undone.
# `terraform destroy` does NOT release the domain: it only removes it from
# state. Turn auto_renew off to let a domain you no longer want expire.
resource "pantechdynamics_domain" "example" {
  name         = "example.com"
  years        = 1
  accept_terms = true

  contact = {
    first_name    = "Ada"
    last_name     = "Obi"
    email         = "ada@example.com"
    phone         = "+234.8012345678"
    address_line1 = "1 Marina"
    city          = "Lagos"
    state         = "Lagos"
    country_code  = "NG"
    postal_code   = "101001"
  }

  # With name_servers unset the domain uses Pantech DNS: serve its records
  # from a zone with the same name.
  depends_on = [pantechdynamics_dns_zone.example]
}

resource "pantechdynamics_dns_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}

# Or delegate to other name servers instead:
#
#   name_servers = ["ns1.example.net", "ns2.example.net"]
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `accept_terms` (Boolean) Must be true: you accept the registration terms. Registering a domain charges your organization's credit and cannot be undone. Changing it later does nothing.
- `contact` (Attributes, Sensitive) The registrant: the person or company who holds the domain. It is personal data, so the block is sensitive. A change is sent to the registrar. A change made outside Terraform is not detected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contact))
- `name` (String) The domain to register, in lower case without a trailing dot, such as "example.com". Changing it registers another domain (and buys it); the old one stays in your organization.

### Optional

- `auto_renew` (Boolean) Renew the domain for a year, from your organization's credit, before it expires. Defaults to true.
- `name_servers` (Set of String) Custom name servers (2 to 6 host names) to delegate the domain to. Leave unset to use Pantech DNS, which needs a pantechdynamics_dns_zone with the domain's name; removing name_servers points the domain back at that zone.
- `privacy` (Boolean) Hide the registrant contact from public registration lookups where the registry allows it. Defaults to true. Always on for .ng domains (.ng, com.ng, org.ng, net.ng, name.ng, mobi.ng, i.ng): the .ng registry hides every registrant's contact details, so false is refused there.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `transfer_lock` (Boolean) Refuse transfers of the domain to another registrar. Defaults to true. Turn it off before transferring the domain away.
- `years` (Number) How many years to register for, 1 to 10. Defaults to 1. Used only when the domain is registered: changing it later does nothing (renewals follow auto_renew). The price is the TLD's register price plus its renew price for each year after the first (see pantechdynamics_domain_tlds).

### Read-Only

- `contact_verified` (Boolean) Whether the registrant clicked the registry's verification email. An unverified registrant is suspended by the registry after 15 days.
- `current_name_servers` (List of String) The name servers the domain is delegated to now, Pantech DNS's or the custom ones.
- `expires_at` (String) When the registration expires, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the domain, starting with dom_.
- `name_server_mode` (String) "pantech" when the domain uses Pantech DNS, "custom" when it uses name_servers.
- `order_id` (String) Id of the registration order (dor_...). Null after an import.
- `registered_at` (String) When the domain was registered, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `status` (String) State of the domain: "registering", "active", "expired", "suspended", "transferred_out" or "failed".
- `tld` (String) The domain's top-level domain, such as "com".
- `zone_id` (String) Id of the Pantech DNS zone (dnsz_...) the domain is delegated to, or null.

<a id="nestedatt--contact"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contact`

Required:

- `address_line1` (String) First address line.
- `city` (String) City.
- `country_code` (String) Two-letter ISO country code in capitals, such as "NG".
- `email` (String) Email address. The registry sends a verification email here.
- `first_name` (String) First name.
- `last_name` (String) Last name.
- `phone` (String) Phone number as +CC.NUMBER, such as "+234.8012345678".

Optional:

- `address_line2` (String) Second address line. Defaults to "".
- `organization_name` (String) The company's name, required when type is "company". Defaults to "".
- `postal_code` (String) Postal code, at most 20 characters. Defaults to "".
- `state` (String) State or province. Defaults to "".
- `type` (String) "person" or "company" (organization_name is then required). Defaults to "person".


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A domain already in your organization is imported by its id. The contact is
# read back once; years and accept_terms only matter when a domain is bought.
terraform import pantechdynamics_domain.example dom_06ggf4abcdefghjkmnpqrstvw
```
